[abstract]
== Abstract

This document provides a definition of a standard Data Format Description
Language (DFDL). This language allows description of text, dense binary, and
legacy data formats in a vendor-neutral declarative manner. DFDL is an
extension to the XML Schema Description Language (XSD).
